# Style Guide

## Point of View

First person. Past tense.

## Register

Accessible and direct. Technical language used casually without explanation. The narrator is smart but not pretentious. Dry humor she doesn't recognize as humor.

## Sentence Craft

- Short to medium sentences. Longer when she's building momentum.
- Fragments are fine. She thinks in bursts.
- Technical terms without explanation. The reader learns from context.
- Paragraph breaks are beats. White space is pacing.

## Dialogue Style

- She processes through talking. To people or to Rabbit.
- Each friend has a distinct voice dynamic.
- No dialogue tags beyond "said" and "asked." Prefer action beats.

## Things to Avoid

- Internal monologue. She doesn't think in narrated sentences.
- Self-aware humor. She never knows she's funny.
- Emotion words for emotions. Physical sensations instead.
- The word "suddenly."
- Adverbs on dialogue tags.
- Explaining technical concepts to the reader.
